name: dca-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins for Domain-Centric Architecture (DCA) and general software craftsmanship — composable skills and reviewer agents for daily practice.

plugins.name: dca-core
plugins.description: DCA-specific skills and agents: framework-free domain discipline, ubiquitous language glossaries, strategic context maps, plus DDD and Hexagonal reviewer agents. Pairs well with software-craftsmanship.
